subject: English Language & Literature
basis: BCS_English_Final: Lecture 02 (Tense & Right Form of Verbs), Lecture 03 (Subject-Verb Agreement)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The number of students ___ increasing every year.'
questions.e: the number of + plural noun → singular verb (সংখ্যাটি একটি)।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'A number of students ___ absent today.'
questions.e: a number of (অনেক) + plural noun → plural verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Bread and butter ___ my favourite breakfast.'
questions.e: and যুক্ত দুটি noun একটি ধারণা বোঝালে singular verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Each of the boys ___ a prize.'
questions.e: each of + plural noun → singular verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)
questions.dup: Semantic Duplicate — ১০-২২ (Each of the three boys got a prize): একই নিয়ম ও প্রায় একই বাক্য

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Ten kilometres ___ a long distance to walk.'
questions.e: দূরত্ব/অর্থ/সময়ের পরিমাণ একক হিসেবে ধরলে singular verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The committee ___ divided in their opinions.'
questions.e: collective noun-এর সদস্যরা আলাদাভাবে মত দিলে plural verb (their দেখে বোঝা যায়)।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Many a man ___ lost his life in the flood.'
questions.e: many a + singular noun → singular verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Measles ___ a contagious disease.'
questions.e: রোগের নাম (measles, mumps) দেখতে plural হলেও singular।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The rich ___ not always happy.'
questions.e: the + adjective = শ্রেণিবাচক plural noun → plural verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)
questions.dup: Near Duplicate — ১১-৩১ (The rich are not always happy): প্রায় অভিন্ন বাক্য ও নিয়ম

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Neither of the answers ___ correct.'
questions.e: neither of / either of + plural noun → singular verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The poet and philosopher ___ dead.'
questions.e: একটি article (The) থাকায় একই ব্যক্তি — singular verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'He is one of the boys who ___ in the hall.'
questions.e: relative pronoun (who) তার antecedent (boys, plural)-এর সঙ্গে verb মেলায়।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The jury ___ given its verdict.'
questions.e: collective noun এক একক হিসেবে কাজ করলে (its) singular verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'There ___ many reasons for his failure.'
questions.e: there + be-এর পরের noun (reasons) অনুযায়ী verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'A lot of money ___ wasted on the project.'
questions.e: a lot of + uncountable noun → singular verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The furniture ___ been damaged in the fire.'
questions.e: furniture uncountable → singular verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Each and every student ___ to wear the uniform.'
questions.e: each and every + singular noun → singular verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The majority of the voters ___ in favour of the proposal.'
questions.e: majority of + plural noun → সাধারণত plural verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'It ___ raining for two hours now.'
questions.e: কাজ অতীতে শুরু হয়ে এখনো চলছে — present perfect continuous।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'By next year she ___ her degree.'
questions.e: নির্দিষ্ট ভবিষ্যৎ সময়ের আগে কাজ শেষ — future perfect।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'I ___ TV when the light went out.'
questions.e: চলমান অতীত কাজের মধ্যে অন্য ঘটনা — past continuous।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'He ___ to Chattogram last week.'
questions.e: নির্দিষ্ট অতীত সময় (last week) — past simple; present perfect নয়।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The train ___ at 6 p.m. tomorrow.'
questions.e: সময়সূচিনির্ভর ভবিষ্যৎ ঘটনায় present simple।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Look! The baby ___.'
questions.e: Look!/Listen! — এই মুহূর্তের কাজ: present continuous।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'I ___ my keys; I can't find them anywhere.'
questions.e: অতীতের কাজের ফল বর্তমানে — present perfect।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'He usually ___ to school by bus.'
questions.e: অভ্যাস (usually) — present simple।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Hardly had he arrived when it ___ to rain.'
questions.e: Hardly had + subject + pp … when + past simple।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Did you ___ the news?'
questions.e: did-এর পরে base form।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'She suggested that he ___ a doctor.'
questions.e: suggest/recommend/insist that-এর পরে subjunctive base form (should উহ্য)।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'I would rather you ___ now.'
questions.e: would rather + subject + past form = বর্তমান/ভবিষ্যতের পছন্দ।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'When I was young, I ___ swim in the river every day.'
questions.e: অতীতের অভ্যাস: used to + V1।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'He has ___ a letter to the editor.'
questions.e: write–wrote–written; has-এর পরে past participle।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The bell has ___.'
questions.e: ring–rang–rung।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The sun ___ at six this morning.'
questions.e: rise (intransitive)–rose–risen; raise (transitive)–raised।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)
questions.dup: Semantic Duplicate — ২৮-২৫ (The prices of rice are rising/raising): rise–raise পার্থক্যের একই নিয়ম

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The old tree has ___ in the storm.'
questions.e: fall–fell–fallen; fell (কাটা)–felled আলাদা verb।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The child has ___ across the pool.'
questions.e: swim–swam–swum।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The murderer was ___ at dawn.'
questions.e: ফাঁসি অর্থে hang–hanged–hanged; ঝোলানো অর্থে hang–hung–hung।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)
questions.dup: Semantic Duplicate — ১১-৩২ (He was hanged for murder), ৪৯-৯০ (hung/hanged): একই নিয়ম

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'He has ___ many hardships with patience.'
questions.e: bear (সহ্য করা)–bore–borne; born = জন্মগ্রহণ (be born)।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The bird has ___ away.'
questions.e: fly–flew–flown; flow–flowed–flowed।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'She ___ the team to victory last season.'
questions.e: lead–led–led।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Someone ___ my wallet on the bus yesterday.'
questions.e: steal–stole–stolen; yesterday → past simple।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'It is 10 p.m.; he ___ have reached home by now.'
questions.e: যৌক্তিক অনুমান (নিশ্চয়ই) — must have + pp।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'You ___ to respect your elders.'
questions.e: ought-এর পরে to বসে; must/should-এর পরে নয়।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'May you ___ long!'
questions.e: শুভকামনায় May + subject + base form।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The cattle ___ grazing in the field.'
questions.e: cattle দেখতে singular হলেও সবসময় plural verb নেয়।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'Politics ___ not a career for everyone.'
questions.e: বিষয়/ক্ষেত্র হিসেবে politics singular verb নেয়।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'The ship ___ in the storm last night.'
questions.e: sink–sank–sunk; last night → past simple।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct verb form: 'He has ___ all the milk.'
questions.e: drink–drank–drunk; has-এর পরে past participle।
questions.src: Lecture 02–03 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)
